newsitem.title: CHINA: HK gold ends shade higher on overseas buying.
newsitem.headline: HK gold ends shade higher on overseas buying.

text.p: Hong Kong spot gold ended a shade higher on Wednesday from New York's previous close on small amounts of overseas buying interest when Europe opened, dealers said.
Bullion closed at US$326.00/50 per ounce, up from New York's Tuesday close at $325.70/326.30.
"There was a small amount of buying in the afternoon and that pushed gold up slightly," said a dealer with a large local bank.
But trading was generally very quiet and medium-term support was seen at $322.00 while gains were seen capped at $330.00.
Tael gold closed HK$15 down at HK$3,018 per tael.
Physical gold demand was not particularly good, dealers said.
The carry over charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society remained unchanged at nil.
